prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate objective function for a GNN-based netlist tier-partitioner (2-tier 3D IC).
Hypothesis of the change: Repair flips correlate positively with score (rho=+0.41) and the quadratic balance term is flat near 50%, so the raw partition drifts and the official repair mangles the learned critical structure; scaling the balance coefficient 10 -> 20 (modest x2, no new mechanism) lands the raw area ratio closer to 0.5 and reduces how much the repair step has to move, preserving the Laplacian's critical-pair locality.
Rule-based digest (scores are improvement ratios vs. the official baseline; C1..C3 are the training circuits by size):
total=+0.044 robust(mean-std)=-0.033 min_case=-0.032 seed_std=0.049 tns_mean=+0.012 all_valid=True
  C1: score=+0.080 dWNS=+10.3% dTNS=+7.5% per-seed=[+0.06 +0.02 +0.16]
  C2: score=-0.032 dWNS=-3.2% dTNS=-3.3% per-seed=[-0.04 -0.04 -0.01]
  C3: score=-0.004 dWNS=+0.2% dTNS=+0.4% per-seed=[+0.04 +0.04 -0.10]
  partition stats vs baseline:
  C1: cut 137->146, wcut 421->431, crit_cross 0.011->0.016, repair_flips 103->118, changed-vs-baseline 17.0%
  C2: cut 318->319, wcut 1007->1006, crit_cross 0.000->0.000, repair_flips 238->240, changed-vs-baseline 7.2%
  C3: cut 582->586, wcut 1955->1969, crit_cross 0.069->0.063, repair_flips 353->350, changed-vs-baseline 9.1%
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID, first classify the failure (crash / non-finite loss / balance repair failure / timeout) and whether it is systematic or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which circuit/metric moved and the plausible mechanism (cut nets, critical-pair cross-tier, repair flips)? (3) is the seed spread acceptable? (4) one concrete next step. No preamble.

response:
(1) No. Repair flips rose (103→118) rather than falling, and crit_cross worsened on C1 (0.011→0.016); the x2 balance scaling did not reduce repair movement as predicted.

(2) C1 drove the gain (score +0.080, dWNS +10.3%) despite higher cut/wcut and crit_cross—so improvement isn't from preserved critical-pair locality; C2 regressed (-0.032), C3 flat. Mechanism unclear/contradicts hypothesis.

(3) No: seed_std=0.049 with robust mean -0.033 and min_case -0.032—gains are seed-fragile, not robust.

(4) Ablate balance coefficient (10/15/20) on C1 alone, logging raw area ratio and repair_flips, to test whether the C1 gain is causal or noise.
